_doc: Already-reported upstream issues. A discrepancy matching an entry is closed as DUPLICATE (open issue) or DESIGN_DIVERGENCE (closed as intended), with the link. Add an entry every time you file or find an issue so the campaign stops re-triaging it. Fields: kind (only_mypy|only_ty|reveal_mismatch|concern_mismatch), silent_tool, codes (diagnostic codes of the reporting tool), message (regex on its message), statement (optional regex on the statement), source (optional regex on the whole program), dismissal, url, note.
